articles.title: ShinyHunters claims it hacked 100 orgs by exploiting an Oracle PeopleSoft 0-day
articles.summary: Oracle's PeopleSoft gets absolutely wrecked by a critical zero-day (CVE-2026-35273) that ShinyHunters used to steal data from 100+ orgs. When criminals find your RCE before you do, you've already lost the game.

articles.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Microsoft sets a new record with 200 security holes in one Patch Tuesday, including 36 critical flaws. It's like watching a software company speedrun their way to irrelevance.

articles.title: Agentjacking Attack Tricks AI Coding Agents Into Running Malicious Code
articles.summary: China-linked Velvet Ant backdoored Linux PAM and OpenSSH for nearly a decade, turning login systems into their personal VIP entrance. The ultimate persistence play that makes rootkits look amateur.

articles.title: Yes to California's Bill to Ban Surveillance Pricing
articles.summary: CISA contractor dumps AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub like it's their personal diary. Congress is big mad, and honestly, they should be.

articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Hackers weaponized Meta's AI support bot to hijack Instagram accounts, including Obama's White House and Space Force leadership. AI assistants: making social engineering great again.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5 Doesn't Change the Mythos Security Story
articles.summary: Section 702 mass surveillance authority faces its final showdown in Congress. EFF says warrant requirement or bust, because warrantless spying is so pre-Snowden.

articles.title: A Point-by-Point Breakdown of Trump’s Failed Iran War Objectives
articles.summary: Hakeem Jeffries grows a backbone and rallies Democrats against extending domestic spy laws. Better late than never, but civil liberties shouldn't require political courage.

articles.title: ‘News’ Site Keeps Hallucinating EFF Staffers
articles.summary: California considers banning surveillance pricing, where corporations charge different prices based on your harvested personal data. Finally, someone noticed the digital discrimination economy.

articles.title: Google Sues Chinese Smishing Network Accused of Using Gemini AI in Phishing
articles.summary: Attackers hijacked 400+ Arch Linux AUR packages to install a Rust-based credential stealer targeting developers. Supply chain attacks: because why hack one dev when you can hack them all?

articles.title: CISA orders federal agencies to “patch smarter”
articles.summary: South Korea fines Coupang $409 million for leaking 33 million customers' data and failing basic breach detection. When your privacy violations cost more than most countries' GDP, you've achieved legendary incompetence.
